title: COAL-SQL: Coverage-Guided Augmentation and Failure-Driven Learning for Text-to-SQL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.20842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL translates natural-language questions into executable SQL queries, but open-source large language models still require task-specific post-training for complex, real-world SQL generation. Effective post-training requires both training data that cover the capabilities demanded by the target task and a learning strategy that enables the model to acquire them. Existing datasets provide valuable supervision but incompletely cover SQL structures, while augmentation methods typically expand data without identifying structural gaps. Moreover, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL) alone cannot dynamically address weaknesses exposed during training. translated_title: COAL-SQL：面向Text-to-SQL后训练的覆盖率引导增强与失败驱动学习
translated_abstract: Text-to-SQL（文本到SQL）任务旨在将自然语言问题转化为可执行的SQL查询，但开源大语言模型在处理复杂、真实场景的SQL生成时，仍需进行针对任务的专门后训练。有效的后训练既需要覆盖目标任务所需能力的训练数据，也需要能让模型掌握这些能力的学习策略。现有数据集提供了宝贵的监督信号，但对SQL结构的覆盖并不完整，而现有的数据增强方法通常只是单纯扩充数据，未能识别结构上的缺口。此外，单独使用监督微调（SFT）或强化学习（RL）均无法动态地解决训练过程中暴露出的模型弱点。我们提出了COAL-SQL，一个结合覆盖率引导增强（Coverage-Guided Augmentation, CGA）与失败驱动学习（Failure-Driven Learning, FDL）的统一框架。CGA利用贪婪选择策略识别原始数据集中缺失的SQL结构，并构建互补的示例，从而改善结构覆盖率（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: COAL-SQL提出一个统一的后训练框架，通过覆盖率引导增强识别SQL结构缺口并生成互补训练数据，再结合失败驱动学习动态弥补训练中暴露的模型弱点，从而提升开源大语言模型在复杂Text-to-SQL任务上的能力。
en_tdlr: COAL-SQL is a unified post-training framework that combines coverage-guided augmentation to fill SQL structural gaps in training data with failure-driven learning to dynamically address model weaknesses, improving open-source LLMs' performance on complex real-world Text-to-SQL tasks.
